_comment: Hex address -> symbol. Hardware names are built in; add RAM names here.

_notes.Joy*: high - sub_009DAC stores held then newly-pressed byte per port; Start = bit 7
_notes.RNG_Seed: high - seeded with $2A6D365A when zero (standard LCG seed)
_notes.DMA_Trigger_Word: high - final VDP DMA command word is written from RAM (68k->VRAM DMA)
_notes.Game_SubState: high - word index (x4) into the jump table at $35E4 (state 1 handler)
_notes.Menu_Cursor: medium - clamped against a per-menu maximum at +6 of a descriptor
_notes.Flags_*: low - only known to be bit flags (bset/bclr/btst); meaning unknown
_notes.Timer_*: medium - loaded with a constant then counted down with subq
